Container.Name: logsaga
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Kodi watch history dashboard. Polls Kodi's shared MariaDB library, records every play (finished or not), caches metadata and artwork locally, and serves a web dashboard. No writes to your Kodi database.

Variable.Name: KODI_DB_HOST
Variable.Description: Hostname or IP of the MariaDB server hosting Kodi's database.

Variable.Name: KODI_DB_PORT
Variable.Description: MariaDB port (default: 3306).

Variable.Name: KODI_DB_USER
Variable.Description: MariaDB user with SELECT-only access on MyVideos%. See docs/setup.md.

Variable.Name: KODI_DB_PASSWORD
Variable.Description: Password for the logsaga MariaDB user.

Variable.Name: KODI_DB_NAME
Variable.Description: Optional: pin to a specific Kodi DB name (e.g. MyVideos131). Leave blank to auto-detect the highest MyVideos% database.

Variable.Name: KODI_JSONRPC_URL
Variable.Description: JSON-RPC URL of your Kodi-Headless instance (e.g. http://YOUR_KODI_HEADLESS_IP:8086/jsonrpc). Used for artwork PrepareDownload.

Variable.Name: KODI_JSONRPC_USER
Variable.Description: Kodi JSON-RPC username (leave blank if no auth).

Variable.Name: KODI_JSONRPC_PASSWORD
Variable.Description: Kodi JSON-RPC password (leave blank if no auth).

Variable.Name: POLL_SECONDS
Variable.Description: How often (seconds) to poll Kodi's database for changes. Default: 30.

Variable.Name: LIBRARY_SYNC_HOURS
Variable.Description: How often (hours) to run a full library sync to pick up new/removed items. Default: 2.0.

Variable.Name: TZ
Variable.Description: Timezone matching your Kodi clients (Kodi writes lastPlayed in client local time). Example: America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London.

Variable.Name: MQTT_HOST
Variable.Description: Hostname or IP of your MQTT broker (e.g. Mosquitto). Leave blank to disable HA discovery.

Variable.Name: MQTT_PORT
Variable.Description: MQTT broker port (default: 1883).

Variable.Name: MQTT_USER
Variable.Description: MQTT username (leave blank if no auth).

Variable.Name: MQTT_PASSWORD
Variable.Description: MQTT password (leave blank if no auth).

Variable.Name: MQTT_DISCOVERY_PREFIX
Variable.Description: MQTT discovery prefix (default: homeassistant).

Variable.Name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
Variable.Description: Public base URL for this app (used in HA sensor URLs). Example: http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:8790.

Variable.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Variable.Description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Default: INFO.

Variable.Name: PUID
Variable.Description: User ID the app runs as. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Variable.Name: PGID
Variable.Description: Group ID the app runs as. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Variable.Name: MIN_STARTED_SECONDS
Variable.Description: Minimum playback position (seconds) before a partial session is kept. Below this it is marked ignored. Default: 120.

Variable.Name: SESSION_GAP_HOURS
Variable.Description: Activity gap (hours) that merges into the same session. Default: 6.

Variable.Name: WATCHED_PERCENT
Variable.Description: Percentage of runtime that counts as watched. Default: 90.

Variable.Name: WATCHED_REMAINING_MINUTES_MOVIE
Variable.Description: Minutes remaining in a movie that counts as watched (credits window). Default: 8.

Variable.Name: WATCHED_REMAINING_MINUTES_EPISODE
Variable.Description: Minutes remaining in an episode that counts as watched (credits window). Default: 3.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent data: SQLite database and artwork cache
